lines.text: Florida's government needs a janitor… a roofer… and someone to spray mosquitoes from an airplane.
Right now there are over 600 open government contracts in Florida. Most small businesses never see them.
Because they're scattered across city, county and school district websites.
So Iggy checks them all every morning, and puts every open bid in one free list.
Pick your county. Pick your trade. Or just search: roofing, landscaping, IT.
Tap a bid, and you're on the official page to apply.
Or get only your kind of bids by email, every morning or once a week.
Don't let your competitor find it first. It's free. Go to floridabids.org.
